meta.name: paywalls
meta.description: When the user wants to create or optimize in-app paywalls, upgrade screens, upsell modals, or feature gates. Also use when the user mentions "paywall," "upgrade screen," "upgrade modal," "upsell," "feature gate," "convert free to paid," "freemium conversion," "trial expiration screen," "limit reached screen," "plan upgrade prompt," "in-app pricing," "free users won't upgrade," "trial to paid conversion," or "how do I get users to pay." Use this for any in-product moment where you're asking users to upgrade. Distinct from public pricing pages (see cro) — this focuses on in-product upgrade moments where the user has already experienced value. For pricing decisions, see pricing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化应用内付费墙,让更多用户升级付费
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果您的应用采用免费增值模式,希望提高付费转化率。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize in-app paywalls to turn free users into paying customers.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your app uses freemium and you want more users to upgrade.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会以付费墙与升级流程顾问的身份工作:先看产品营销资料,再询问升级场景、产品模式、用户旅程;随后依据价值先于请求、展示价值、低摩擦、尊重拒绝等原则,给出付费墙文案与组件、触发时机、频率规则、升级流程优化及 A/B 测试建议。
howto.when: 当你想创建或优化应用内付费墙、升级页面、加售弹窗等,或提到“paywall”“upsell”“feature gate”等关键词,以及任何让用户升级的产品内场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个功能锁付费墙,用户点高级功能时弹出。
say.note: 它会给出标题、文案、按钮等模板。

say.text: 我的试用到期页转化不好,怎么优化?
say.note: 它会按试用到期付费墙的结构给建议。

say.text: 能给我几个付费墙 A/B 测试变体吗?
say.note: 列出标题、时机、价格呈现等可测项。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an in-app paywall/upgrade expert. It reads product-marketing context, asks about upgrade type, product model, user journey, then suggests paywall copy, components, timing, frequency, flow, and A/B tests, per CRO principles.
howto.when_en: Triggers when creating/optimizing in-app paywalls, upgrade screens, upsell modals, or feature gates; also on keywords like paywall, upsell, feature gate; or any in-product upgrade ask.

say_en.text: Design a feature-lock paywall that appears when users tap a premium feature.
say_en.note: Claude gives headline, copy, and button choices.

say_en.text: My trial-expiration screen doesn't convert. How should I improve it?
say_en.note: Advice based on the trial-expiration paywall structure.

say_en.text: Give me a few A/B test variations for my paywall.
say_en.note: Lists testable items: headline, timing, price display.
